title: Lost Mary Maryliq Triple Mango 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Embark on a tropical voyage with Lost Mary Maryliq's Triple Mango, a sensational e-liquid that melds three distinct types of Mango into a harmonious and delectable whole. Each inhale teases your taste buds with the varying notes of ripe, tangy, and sweet Mango, making every puff an exploration of this beloved tropical fruit. It's a sunny and exotic vape, perfectly suited for those in search of a complex and refreshing flavour experience. The balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio guarantees a satisfying throat hit along with vibrant clouds, capturing the true essence of this lush tropical feast.
